name: backdrops
description: Claude Code mod: a scene behind the conversation in the desktop app, with a matching dark color theme. Fourteen themes: two F1 (Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes #12, Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari #44), six travel (space shuttle, Mt Fuji, Paris, Rome, Swiss Alps, Tokyo Shibuya) and six retro (Matrix, retro 80s, Windows XP, Windows 98, Macintosh, Linux), switched from a picker above the chat box or /backdrops:<name>.
